description: Directory of European underground gas storage sites and LNG terminals reporting to GIE (AGSI+ / ALSI+): every storage system operator and LNG operator by country, with each facility's name, type and EIC code and operational dates. Use it to find which storage sites or LNG terminals a country has, or the EIC codes the other GIE tools filter on. Keyless.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "DE".

include_closed.description: Also list facilities with an operational end date (decommissioned or historical series). Default false.

query.description: Case-insensitive name fragment or exact EIC code of an operator or facility, e.g. "Rehden", "Uniper", "Zeebrugge".

name: gie_storage_facilities
title: Gie Storage Facilities
